verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's first-party docs have a dedicated Webhooks section. It covers async event delivery for crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, and monitor-check lifecycle events (start, progress, finish) to a user-provided HTTPS endpoint. The docs also cover HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and how to test locally by exposing a server publicly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that webhook delivery works as documented.
